in_arabic.name: مجمل
in_arabic.long_meaning: مجمل means Compact, Complete in Arabic. This name is derived from the root letters 'J-M-L' in Arabic, which carry the general meaning of 'gathering, assembling, collecting, or completing'. Names derived from this root are often used to describe individuals who possess strong character traits such as being thorough, reliable, and comprehensive.

In the Quran, the name is used in reference to Allah (God), who is the ultimate Crusher and Overwhelmer of all things.
